subject: Exec sanction request — CareBridge POC uplift & 60-day sandbox extension
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com, lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-12T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Exec sanction request — CareBridge POC uplift & 60-day sandbox extension

Team,

Quick context: CareBridge (regulated regional healthcare provider) is deep in an EMR integration POC. Procurement has delayed their PO because they need an internal security addendum review and vendor onboarding for their data governance team. The engineering team at CareBridge needs a longer sandbox window to complete an E2E validation (they surface patient-like data in a synthetic environment) and they’ve asked for extra complimentary credits to cover the extended integration work while the PO clears.

Why this matters: this is a high-propensity account (DB-4732) — expected ARR ~$300k in year one if the POC converts. They’ve been engaged with our solutions team for 8 weeks; legal+security signoff is likely but slow because of their internal compliance board. If we can keep the POC running without throttling they’ve said they’ll sign an enterprise contract on completion.

Asks (one-off, exec signoff requested):
- Approve a one-time free-credit uplift equivalent to $15,000 of usage (token credit) to sustain the POC until PO is issued.
- Extend the sandbox/Pilot window from our standard 30 days to 90 days (they requested 60–90; I’m asking for 60 as a minimum fallback).
- Allow a temporary billing hold / waive immediate invoicing until their PO processes (expected ~30–45 days).

Risk mitigation: we will require a signed mutual action plan (attached) and a short addendum to the MSA that limits credits to the POC environment and revokes credits if they export production data. Sales and Solutions will own tracking in HubSpot; we’ll add a usage cap alert and require the customer to provide an estimated PO date.

Attachments: CareBridge_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, POC_SOW_v2.pdf

Target decision timeline: need exec position today (EOD) to avoid downtime next week.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if helpful.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec sanction request — CareBridge POC uplift & 60-day sandbox extension

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise ask and the ARR context. I’m prepared to make a one-off concession to keep the momentum. Approve the following interim terms:

- One-time free-credit uplift: APPROVED at 50% of request ($7,500).
- Sandbox extension: APPROVED to 60 days (not 90).

Conditions: any additional credit above $7.5k and any billing hold beyond 30 days requires CFO sign-off (copying finance for awareness). Legal must prepare a short addendum that explicitly ties credits to the POC environment and requires the signed MAP. Please have Sales Ops coordinate the DocuSign flow; add a clause that credits are non-transferable.

Proceed with the addendum and notify the customer of the approved (reduced) uplift — we should be explicit that this is an exception. Keep me updated if they push back.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com, lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com, aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-12T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec sanction request — CareBridge POC uplift & 60-day sandbox extension

Thanks Rishi / Karthik — I’ll draft the addendum and the DocuSign packet immediately. Planned checklist:
- Create addendum (use addendum_template.docx): tie credits to DB-4732 POC environment, 60-day sandbox extension start date to be anchored to signed addendum date.
- Generate DocuSign envelope and populate SOW + MAP + addendum. Link: https://docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF123456
- Create HubSpot task and set a 30-day billing-hold flag for finance review.

Karthik — I need:
1) Final estimated PO date from CareBridge (even if rough).
2) Cost center to route internal accounting for the one-off credit.
3) Confirmation that the engineering team is OK with a 60-day window (not 90).

I’ll also indicate in the DocuSign cover note that this is an exec-approved exception (approved by CRO) and that any further uplift requires CFO approval.

— Marissa
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com
To: Simone Park <simone@carebridgehealth.com>, Michael Torres <m.torres@carebridgehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-12-12T15:31:00-08:00
Subject: Approved: interim uplift and 60-day extension (CareBridge POC)

Simone / Michael —

Good news: our executive team has approved a one-time uplift to keep your pilot running while procurement completes the PO. Approved interim terms:

- Complimentary usage credit: $7,500 one-time credit applied to the POC environment.
- Sandbox extension: 60-day extension from the date of the signed addendum.
- Billing hold: we can accommodate a billing hold up to 30 days; beyond that we need a PO or CFO approval.

Next steps (I’ve looped Sales Ops):
1) You’ll receive a DocuSign packet (SOW + MAP + short addendum) from Redwood in the next hour. Please sign the addendum to confirm the sandbox start date. Link will come from DocuSign.
2) Please share an estimated PO issuance date so internal teams can track.
3) Engineering: we will keep the dedicated sandbox available and monitor usage; if you anticipate heavy token usage please flag us.

Attachments: POC_SOW_v2.pdf, CareBridge_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (addendum to follow).

Thanks for your partnership — we want to make sure you can finish the EMR integration validation without interruptions.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
